problems.title: Quantization error alone does not order full reconstruction error
problems.source_location: Appendix A, Proposition 2, PDF p.15, Eq.(15); Claim 2 SVD setup
claim: Proposition 2 compares \(\|Q(A)+Q(B)-A-B\|_F\) with \(\|Q(A+B)-A-B\|_F\) and infers the same ordering for approximation of the original matrix \(W\).
analysis: Put \(T=W-A-B\), \(d=Q(A)+Q(B)-A-B\), and \(e=Q(A+B)-A-B\). Actual errors are \(\|T-d\|_F\) and \(\|T-e\|_F\), so their squared difference contains \(-2\langle T,d-e\rangle_F\). A complete counterexample uses the same entrywise sign quantizer on each nonzero entry and orthogonal matrices \[U=\frac13\begin{pmatrix}1&-2&-2\\-2&1&-2\\-2&-2&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad V=\frac13\begin{pmatrix}-1&-2&-2\\-2&2&-1\\-2&-1&2\end{pmatrix}.\] Set \(W=U\operatorname{diag}(3,2,1)V^\top\), \(A=3u_1v_1^\top\), \(B=2u_2v_2^\top\). Thus \(A+B\) is genuinely the rank-two truncated SVD with a nonzero third-mode tail. Direct rational arithmetic gives \(\|d\|_F^2=7/3<32/9=\|e\|_F^2\), but total squared errors \(\|W-Q(A)-Q(B)\|_F^2=10/3>3=\|W-Q(A+B)\|_F^2\). No zero-entry convention, numerical SVD or changed quantizer explains the reversal.
result: The stated sufficient condition is incomplete; learned residual quantization-aware training itself is not refuted.
assumptions: Only the cited paper version and explicitly described mathematical or implementation conditions are assessed.
repair: The exact criterion is \(\|d\|_F^2-\|e\|_F^2<2\langle T,d-e\rangle_F\). If the cross terms vanish, the simpler comparison becomes sufficient under that additional condition.
problems.impact_rationale: This is a local proposition used as motivation, with no demonstrated failure of the main learned method.
problems.existing_correction_status: An explicit local correction is described; author adoption and a corresponding published erratum are not established.

problems.title: Factorized weights do not themselves imply a latent KV cache
problems.source_location: Current arXiv v5 Section 5, PDF p.10; Figure 5 and Table 4, PDF p.9; quantization/modules/attention.py, PhiQKVSplitAttention.forward
claim: Section 5 states that latent vectors are cached rather than full-dimensional keys/values, while Table 4 labels its cache reduction as estimated. The current author quantization/modules/attention.py instead projects full-width keys and values, applies RoPE and passes those tensors to Cache.update.
analysis: Weight-factor multiplication and cache representation are distinct. Passing full-width key/value tensors does not implement the proposed latent state by itself. A separately implemented cache could transform them, but no such implementation is established in this traced path. The paper’s conceptual and estimated qualifiers remain material.
result: Latent-cache implementation and measured storage savings are not established by this source path.
assumptions: Only the cited paper version and explicitly described mathematical or implementation conditions are assessed.
repair: Identify cache reduction as a prospective/estimated design unless the compatible state layout and decode path are supplied. No new cache algorithm is validated here.
problems.impact_rationale: This is implementation scope and evidence of a full-width interface, not proof that the conceptual storage arithmetic is false.
problems.existing_correction_status: An explicit local correction is described; author adoption and a corresponding published erratum are not established.

problems.title: The rank convention in the bit-budget table is unresolved
problems.source_location: Appendix D, PDF pp.19–20, Eqs.(16)–(17); Appendix H, Table 13, PDF p.24
claim: Appendix D counts two equal-rank paths, while Table 13 reports latent dimension \(R\) and nominal bit-per-weight labels for a primary-path microbenchmark.
analysis: Interpreting the table’s rank as the rank of each path approximately doubles the nominal bit budget. A primary-only or total-rank convention explains much of that discrepancy, and the paper explicitly identifies primary-path timing. Kernel configuration and included scaling overhead are needed to choose the correct accounting.
result: The timing table is not disproved; the rank and payload convention needs additional evidence.
assumptions: Only the cited paper version and explicitly described mathematical or implementation conditions are assessed.
problems.impact_rationale: Competing interpretations remain viable, so a supported scientific error is not assigned.
problems.existing_correction_status: No validated correction is established for this item.
